pickFailed: Folio couldn't open the folder dialog

welcome.title: Welcome to Folio
welcome.intro: Your course files in one library: semesters and courses, tags, quick search and a preview for every file. It stays an ordinary folder on this computer.

newLibrary.title: Start a new library
newLibrary.text: Choose an empty folder. Folio adds a folder for each semester and course as you create them.

existing.title: Use a folder you already have
existing.text: Choose the folder that holds your semester folders. Nothing is moved or renamed.

welcome.openLead: Used Folio on this computer before?
welcome.footer: Folio works offline. It doesn't collect usage data.

folder.notEmpty: This folder isn't empty, so Folio can use it as it is.
folder.isEmpty: This folder is empty, so Folio starts a new library in it.

empty.title: Start a new library
empty.intro: Folio keeps your library in this folder. Semester and course folders go inside it.
empty.note: Folio adds a hidden .folio folder here for your tags and course settings. Everything else stays ordinary files that open without Folio.

folders.title: Use this folder as your library
folders.intro: Folio works with the folders you already have.
folders.note: Folio adds a hidden .folio folder here for your tags and course settings. Nothing is moved or renamed.

library.title: Open your library
library.bannerTitle: This folder is already a Folio library
library.bannerText: Open it to pick up where you left off. Its tags, courses and settings are inside it.

insideLibrary.title: Choose another folder
insideLibrary.bannerTitle: This folder is inside another library
insideLibrary.bannerText: {{root}} is a Folio library, and a library can't hold another one. Choose that folder to open it, or a folder outside it.

incomplete.title: Finish setting up this library
incomplete.bannerTitle: Folio started a library here but didn't finish
incomplete.bannerText: Its hidden .folio folder has no library file, maybe because the disk was full or Folio closed. Folio can finish now and keep what's already there, like your tags.

map.label: How Folio reads your folders · example

folder.topFiles_one: The file at the top level stays where it is. Search finds it.
folder.topFiles_other: The {{count, number}} files at the top level stay where they are. Search finds them.

sync.iCloud: This folder is in iCloud Drive
sync.other: This folder is in a cloud folder
sync.text: iCloud can change or re-download files while Folio uses them, which leaves conflict copies. Keep your library outside iCloud, OneDrive and Dropbox. A later version of Folio backs it up to iCloud for you.

name.label: Library name
name.help: Shown in Library settings. It doesn't change the folder's name.

errors.NameEmpty: Enter a name for the library.
errors.NameInvalidCharacter: Remove line breaks and other control characters.

alreadyALibrary.title: This folder is part of a Folio library
alreadyALibrary.text: This folder is already a Folio library, or is inside one. Open that library instead, or choose another folder.

accessDenied.title: Folio can't write to this folder
accessDenied.text: Windows didn't allow it. Choose a folder in your user folder, such as Documents, or on another drive.

choiceExpired.title: Choose the folder again
choiceExpired.text: A folder choice lasts 10 minutes, and this one ran out. Nothing was created.

notALibrary.title: This folder isn't a Folio library
notALibrary.text: It has no .folio folder. Choose the folder that has one, or go back and start a new library.

newerFormat.title: This library needs a newer Folio
newerFormat.text: A newer version of Folio saved it. Update Folio, then open it again. Your files are fine.

diskFull.title: The disk is full
diskFull.text: Free up some space on {{drive}}, then try again.
diskFull.textNoDrive: Free up some space on the disk, then try again.

failed.title: Folio couldn't set up the library here
failed.text: Something went wrong while writing to the folder. Try again, or choose another folder.

courses.title: Add your semester and courses
courses.intro: Folio makes a folder for the semester and one inside it for each course.
courses.introNoFolders: This folder has no semester folders yet.
courses.label: Courses
courses.help: Press Enter in a name to add another row. You can change colours and badge letters later in Library settings.

semester.NameInvalidCharacter: A semester name can't contain \ / : * ? " < > | because it becomes a folder name.

course.NameInvalidCharacter: A course name can't contain \ / : * ? " < > | because it becomes a folder name.
course.AlreadyExists: Another course in {{semester}} already has this name.
course.AlreadyExistsHere: Another course in this semester already has this name.

folder.NameTrailingDotOrSpace: A folder name can't end with a dot or a space.
folder.NameReserved: Windows reserves this name, like CON or NUL. Choose another.
folder.NameTooLong: This name is too long for a folder. Shorten it.
folder.PathTooLong: The folder's full path would be too long for Windows. Use a shorter name.

code.NameInvalidCharacter: Remove line breaks and other control characters.

review.title: Check your semesters and courses
review.intro: Add course codes if you like: they go before course names and in paths.
review.readingHelp: You can finish now. Folio keeps reading in the background and shows its progress in the toolbar.
review.semesterHelp: Each folder at the top level is a semester: {{names}}.
review.noCourses: Folio hasn't found course folders in {{semester}} yet.
review.laterNote: You can change all of this later in Library settings.

missing.title: Can't find your library
missing.text: Folio keeps your library in the folder below, but it isn't there. If you moved or renamed it, show Folio where it is now. If it's on a drive that isn't connected, connect the drive and try again.

notALibrary.title: Your library's settings are missing
notALibrary.text: The folder below is still there, but its hidden .folio folder is missing or damaged, so Folio can't find your tags and course settings. If you have a copy of that folder, put it back and try again.

newerFormat.title: This library needs a newer Folio
newerFormat.text: A newer version of Folio saved this library. Update Folio, then open it again. Your files are fine.

accessDenied.title: Folio can't open your library
accessDenied.text: Windows denied access to the folder below. Check that you can open it in File Explorer, then try again.

catalogFailed.title: Folio can't open its search index
catalogFailed.text: Your files are fine, but the index Folio keeps on this computer couldn't be opened. This happens when another copy of Folio is running or the disk is full. Close other copies of Folio, then try again.

cantStart.title: Folio can't start
cantStart.dataDir: It can't find a place on this computer to keep its data. Restart Folio. If this keeps happening, copy the details and send them to the developer.
cantStart.transport: This window can't reach the rest of Folio. Restart Folio.
